The '''Nova Room''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] owned by [[Kris Wahl]] in [[Port Tooga]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Listehol system/Legends|Listehol system]] controlled by [[Shoola]].
